Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for taking the call last week. Attached is the draft sponsorship package for the curated track at DevSummit (attached: DevSummit_Sponsorship_Agreement_v3_redlines.pdf). Highlights:
- Curated Track Sponsor (Premier): 20-min onstage speaking slot (front-stage), guaranteed logo on main stage backdrop, premium expo pod (3x3), 8 expo passes, and mobile app featured listing.
- Headline logo placement on main stage (base size) + one pre-roll slide in keynote.
- Fee: $65,000 (includes one 90-minute demo time block on expo floor)

We have room to accommodate a slightly longer slot if you want — current speaking schedule is tight but we can push for 30 minutes if you confirm quickly.

Questions for you:
- Would you prefer a 30-min keynote instead of the standard 20?
- Do you need an AV rider or additional staging?

Please review the redlines (minor language around content rights) and the floorplan link in the doc. If this looks OK I can send a DocuSign link for signature and reserve the front-stage placement.

Hi Sophie — thanks for the draft and the quick turnaround. Quick responses below and a few asks before we sign: 

1) Speaking slot: We would strongly prefer a 30-min front-stage session (25-min talk + 5-min live Q&A). If that's not available, please hold the best possible 20-min slot and confirm an option to upgrade if another sponsor drops.

2) Logo placement: We need front-stage logo to be guaranteed at 1.5x the base size for the Premier tier and placement in the printed program and mobile app feature. Can you confirm exact pixel requirements for the stage assets?

3) Demo pod: The 3x3 expo pod is fine but we need guaranteed adjacent power and a 6ft table; please confirm demo pod specs and whether we can have a lockable cabinet.

4) Privacy clause: For the demo pod we require a clause that event staff will not retain attendee data collected from our devices; can you add a short data-handling statement to the agreement or confirm you will not collect demo data on our behalf?

5) Deliverables & hits: Please confirm number of pre-roll plays, onstage callouts (x2), and branded email mention — we want these listed in the SOW.

If you can send a DocuSign link with our requested redlines incorporated (or highlight where you cannot accommodate changes), we'll move quickly. CC-ing Lauren and Tessa to help with logistics and AV.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Head of Event Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Lauren/Tessa — drafting negotiation bullets to send Sophie. My asks to lock before signature: 
- Confirm 30-min front-stage or guaranteed upgrade clause + one recorded backup (pre-recorded talk with live on-stage Q&A) if schedule changes.
- Require mobile app featured listing + 2 push notifications (one pre-event, one during the show) and inclusion in three pre-show emails.
- Cap on sponsor mentions during the keynote (no more than two other sponsor shout-outs in the same session).
- Demo pod: insist the lockable cabinet is included at no extra cost for Premier tier; otherwise agree to $250 cap (negotiable).
- AV/tech: 1 dedicated line-check slot and 30-min tech rehearsal on stage prior to show.

Also confirm we need 10 expo passes (rather than 8) — saves flight coordination later.

If these are good I'll send the reply to Sophie and ask Marcus to update the DocuSign.

-Kim
